content: Yana na akatate bhabhe
Na mangota akayana majhokanikiye akatate bhino, nhwalo munnyeketela Bhambo, chenie ndi kilebhe chamaha hake.
Ngita Majhandiko gha Chapanga chighalonge, “Munyokanikiye tate na majhe gwino.” Ghono ndi nhilo gwa kutumbula mu mihilo, nhilo gwene ulonge,
“Mme na ughome na ntame yaka twe pannema.”
Na mangota akatate mangabhehe na milomojhe kwa yana hino, nambo mwalele ngita chapala Bhambo, na kwa kwabhola mambu gheniya chibhipalwa kutama mbone.
Akabhanda na akanahota bhabhe
Mangota akabhanda, majhokanikiye akanahota bhino bha pannema pano kwa mwojho ghoha na kujhoghopa, ntende gheniya kwa kuhangana mwojho ngita munhenge Kilichitu.
Pimuhenga yenio chi pibhanoleke tuu jhe kupala mmonekane bhamaha, nambo unhenga kwa mwojho gwino ngita chapala Chapanga nhwalo mangotamwe ndi makabhanda bha Kilichitu.
Pimuhenga mahengo, nhenge lihengo kwa kuhanganila ngita munhenge Bhambo na kwahenge bhando.
Nkomboka kubhehe Bhambo nampela ndweko mundo jhojhoha jwahenga ghambone, abhehe mmanda amu jwangabhehe mmanda.
Na akanahota mwahengela hele ngita akabhanda bhino, nkotoka kwatenda bhanyoghope. Nkomboka mangota hele ngita bhene, nkwete Bhambo jhojho kunane kwa Chapanga, na jwenio ihengajhe kwa kuhaghula.
Ngondo ya uhuke
Bhahe, nimpalangana mme nganganga mu kulombana nde na Bhambo na kutangatilwa kwa makakala ghake makolongwa.
Uwalangane chilaha ya ngondo yampekengine Chapanga kupala ndi nhoto kujhema na kukenga makakala gha Limbembela.

Nhwalo kukomana kwito tukomana jhe na bhando, nambo tukomana na lilongo lya akakomana ngondo gwa michuka kunane ku mahunde bhina ulongoche na akanahota bhina ukindendeke bhibhalongocha nnema gwa lubhendo.
nhwalo gwenio, uhwale chilaha yampekiye Chapanga ndi muhimbilile ade puipala kujhomoka ngondo, pukujhomolela nahotola kujhema nganganga.
Bhahe, nnyeme nganganga, chakaka mme ngita luhunga mu kibhuno chino, na mu kuhenga ghapala Chapanga ngita kikopa chikihibhilikiya panganga jhino,
kilolo chu kutangacha Lilobhe lya Mbone lya uteeke libhehe ngita maghubache mu makongono ghino.
Panane jha gheniya, kihobholelo chino machiko ghoha kibhaha ngita ngao mu mabhoko ghino, jhihoto kuhibhilikiya mahonga ghina mwotu gha Limbembela.
Mupokele ughombokeko ngita kofiya jhino jha choma, lilobhe lya Chapanga ngita upanga ghumpatite na Uhuke gwa Chapanga.

Nhenge gheniya ghoha kwa kunnyopa Chapanga antangatile. Munyopengane Chapanga machiko ghoha ngita Uhuke gwa Chapanga chanongocha. Nkeluangana changatotokela mu kunnyopa Chapanga kwa bhando bha Chapanga bhoha.
Helahela unnyopela na nenga, hele punilonge na bhando, Chapanga ambela chukulonge, nhoto kwatangachila bhando chile jha Lilobhe lya Mbone lya Yecho Kilichitu changapwelela.
Nenga ndi majhumba kome jwa Lilobhe lya Mbone lyenio pamo na kubhehe mukipungo. Unyope ngotoka kubhehe na kiholo mu kutangacha ngita chiipalwa.
Malobhe gha kujhomolela
Tikiko, nnongo gwito jhutumpahile na ntumiche jwahobholeka mukulombana na Bhambo, nannobholela mambu ghango ghoha kupala mmanyengane chinihenga.
Nintuma kwino nhwalo gwa lilobhe lende na anobholele malobhe ghito kupala ankangamalicha mwojho.
Ninyopelangana akalongo bhango uteeke na upalano na kihobholelo kubhoka kwa Chapanga Tate na kubhoka kwa Bhambo Yecho Kilichitu.
Ninyopelangana umbone gwa Chapanga ubhaha kwa bhando bhoha bhibhampala Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu kwa upalo gwangapehekeya.
